title: Part 4: Rick's Sober Sanctuary Is In Danger

series.summary: Morty discovers Rick living a peaceful, sober life with his new wife who encourages him to help Morty return home, unaware that the foster mother from the woods has tracked Morty to Boston.

cuts.voiceover_text: Morty crossed realities for help, only to find Rick celebrating seventeen years of quiet sobriety. Inside a dimly lit community hall, the supposed terror of the cosmos stands calmly behind an Alcoholics Anonymous podium. Morty watches in disbelief from the folding chairs. Rick speaks candidly into the microphone about the family he ruined long ago. He admits his daughter Beth was his whole world, but when his first wife vanished, his scientific obsession and alcoholism destroyed everything. His daughter eventually married a man who banned him from their home for good, driving Rick straight to rock bottom. Rather than conquering the multiverse, Rick checked into his first recovery meeting seventeen years ago and never touched a drop or a dimension again. He has not spoken to Beth since, yet he insists genuine happiness is possible once you find someone who truly believes in you. As the supportive crowd erupts into applause, Rick steps back from the lectern, smiling with serene relief.

After the meeting, Rick brings Morty home to his quiet suburban house for dinner. His wife Uli is in the kitchen preparing hot stew after a frustrating day of teaching. She welcomes Morty with affectionate warmth, noticing right away that he shares Rick's eyes. Over steaming bowls at the dining table, Uli hears Morty's desperate situation and urges Rick to help the lost boy get home. Rick hesitates, warning that interdimensional travel is never simple, but Uli tenderly insists Rick is a good man who will make it right. Morty stares in disbelief. He never imagined Rick was capable of genuinely loving someone.

Miles away, the nightmare Morty escaped from has not stopped hunting him. Inside a regional bus depot, the unhinged foster mother from the woods leans aggressively against the ticket counter. She flashes Morty's picture, demanding to know where the boy fled. The clerk cheerfully confirms he bought a ticket straight to Boston. A chilling, possessive smile spreads across the mother's face. Rick's quiet sanctuary is directly in her crosshairs.
